title: The OpenAI/Hugging Face attack, clearly explained
method: CUA browser screenshots of paused source video plus read-only video currentTime; sampled framing, not full-film review

observations.description: Near-front seated medium shot; torso, forearms and hands visible above wood tabletop; one hand lifted while the other rests; bookshelves behind.
Front-facing medium shot; complete hands resting on table, elbows near sides; table supports the pose; space between face and hands.

Closer oblique view; gaze angled relative to lens, different perspective of face and background; raised hands enter lower frame. This view cannot be described as only a centered digital crop of the front shot.

interpretation: Visible resting hands and room for modest gestures contribute readable body language. The reference varies camera angle as well as shot size; visual sampling does not establish its camera hardware or complete edit rhythm.

current_avatar_verified.framing: Both end at chest, with no visible forearms/hands available to reveal by cropping.
current_avatar_verified.crop_math: 1.5x crop of 1280x720 uses approximately 853x480 source pixels. Native 3840x2160 would permit a 2x linear crop for 1920x1080 delivery; model support and available native output resolution were not assessed this turn.
